27. REMOVE CYLINDER HEAD
(a) Disconnect the upper radiator hoses from the water hose
union.
(b) Disconnect the heater water hose from the water hose
union.
{c) Using a 1 O mm bi-hexagon wrench, uniformly loosen and
remove the 10 cylinder head bolts, in several passes, in
the sequence shown. Remove the 1 o cylinder head bolts
and plate washers.
NOTICE:
Head warpage or cracking could result from removing
bolts in an incorrect order.
